newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes flat in stable market.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes flat in stable market.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed unchanged for the third successive day at 473.75/474.75 per dollar Friday as moderate foreign currency demand was met by the Central Bank, traders said.
"There was some demand from corporate clients but less than in previous days. In any case the Central Bank remained alert as the only seller," one trader said.
"At the end of the day a few banks were buying and the rate went up but the Central Bank entered and covered (the demand)," another trader said.
Traders said they saw the exchange rate varying little next week with the Central Bank meeting slightly increased market demand for foreign currency.
